POC scope and success criteria:
- Scope: 3-week Dedicated POC using a single GPU pool in us-east-1 with canary traffic routing, KV prefix caching enabled, and automatic fallback to Hosted variants.
- Success metrics: average request latency (p99) < 350ms for chat; mean token cost reduction >= 40% relative to Hosted baseline; zero production-quality regressions on 200 eval prompts.

Technical POC plan (high level):
- Week 0 (prep): infra provisioning, credentials, KMS integration, model upload + quantization profile. Drive runbook: /drive/redwood/poc-checklist/sfj-dedicated-poc-runbook.md
- Week 1 (canary): route 5% of live traffic to Dedicated pool using canary policy. Monitor latency, error rates, and quality drift via eval set.
- Week 2 (scale): raise to 25% then 60% based on metrics. Test autoscaling behaviors under synthetic load.
- Week 3 (full + rollback drills): move to 100% if stable; run region failover test (us-east -> us-west -> eu-west) with simulated region outage; exercise automatic rollback based on SLO breach triggers.

Canary + fallback routing specifics:
- Canary policy: 5% initial, 3-step ramp (5% -> 25% -> 60%) gated on p95 latency and quality score thresholds.
- Model variants: production model = gf-34b-quant; fallback hosted variant = gf-34b-serve (higher cost, same quality); lightweight variant = gf-8b-llm for degraded mode.
- Fallback rules: on Dedicated capacity shortage or unhealthy nodes, automatically route to Hosted gf-34b-serve in same region. If Hosted region also degraded, route to lightweight gf-8b-llm in nearest healthy region.
- Region failover plan: primary us-east-1, secondary us-west-2, tertiary eu-west-1. Test plan includes simulated AZ/region outage at 60% traffic, verify session continuity for chat within 10s and graceful degradation of throughput.
- Rollback triggers: >2x error rate over baseline OR p95 latency >500ms for 5 consecutive minutes OR quality regression (BLEU/ROUGE-style metric) > 6% on eval set. Rollback action = immediate routing to previous stable model + alert to SRE + automated incident create (REDWOOD-1289).
